PaneContent.description:
What a pane holds. The nested-panes design makes a pane's content kind either
a terminal or an extension view.

A client that does not know a future kind degrades to [`PaneContent::Unknown`]
rather than rejecting the response, and an omitted value means
[`PaneContent::Terminal`] for older servers and clients.

content.description:
What this pane holds. Omitted (the default) means a terminal, so a
terminal pane's info is unchanged for older readers; a view pane carries
`content: "view"`.

terminal_id.description: The pane's terminal. Absent for a view pane, never the empty string.

terminal_size.description:
The pane's live terminal size: the rows and columns its PTY and terminal
core have now. A pane whose terminal a client claimed for a panel is
smaller than its layout rect by the panel's band, so this is the size to
compare against the pane's own rows.

timeout_ms.description: Startup timeout in milliseconds. Values must be greater than 3000 and at most 300000.

ClientShellSurfaceSetParams.description: Updates whether the requesting client shell receives and controls pane presentation.

command_id.description: Opaque endpoint-issued command identifier from the client-shell projection.

selection.description: Client-owned selection coordinates, validated against the pane's content revision.

enabled.description: `null` restores global enablement for this repository.

approved.description:
Update discovery may stage a version, but package replacement requires
an explicit approval from a host-owned confirmation UI.

LayoutPathStep.description: Structural request-local addresses; wrappers consume no step or identity.

PaneViewParams.description:
The neutral view-pane operation. `add` puts a view pane beside a pane; the
extension and view identity are supplied by the caller, never by a core
Tasks literal. `close` drops a view pane. Views are read-only content.

direction.description: Split direction for `add`; defaults to right.

extension.description: The extension that publishes the view ("vqro.tasks").

ratio.description:
Explicit manual VIEW share (0.1..=0.9). Omit for transient auto sizing;
the initial tree fallback is 0.5, not a persistent auto policy.

view.description: The view id the extension publishes ("tasks").

oneOf.description: Outer popup size in terminal cells, including the border.
Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

source_workspace_id.description: Workspace whose focused pane supplies the `follow` cwd policy.

execution.description: Cooperative process-lifetime proof on explicit list/get only; absent if unprovable.

artifact_verified.description:
True when an artifact verified at installation remains in managed storage.
Activation and rollback re-verify its digests before use.

install_supported.description: Whether this host can perform a fresh installation of the package.

integration_status.description: Deployment state of an agent adapter, distinct from package install state.

requested_capabilities.description:
Capabilities requested by executable package services. An empty list means
that this catalog item has no downloaded executable service.

view.description: View only: this item's view blocks. A legacy document never carries it.

oneOf.description:
Routed only to the provider identified by the enclosing document's
namespace and generation. `name` is never resolved globally.

A fixed host-owned effect. The provider must hold the corresponding
capability and the host still validates the referenced identity.

placement.description: Optional, ephemeral placement context for resolving host interactions.

terminal_id.description:
Stable runtime identity. It does not change when a pane moves, is
promoted from a group, or is shown by another client.

HostViewItem.description:
The view blocks of one item. Every field is optional: an item with no view
block is a plain group, and an unknown future block degrades to
"unsupported" instead of rejecting the view.

action.description:
What the row is waiting for, in one short word ("unblock", "report").
Vqro composes the sentence around it, so the row never spells out
bookkeeping of its own.

kind.description:
What this block is, as a free string so the set can grow: `section` and
`row` are known, and anything else is drawn as "unsupported" in place
rather than dropped. Never a closed enum: an unknown variant would make
an older client reject the whole view.

pane_id.description:
A panel root: the pane whose panel this item's subtree fills. Only a
root item (no parent) may set it. Vqro draws the pane's bottom edge slot.

since.description:
Unix epoch seconds whose age Vqro draws. Only the extension knows what
the instant means.

state.description:
A row state, or a panel root's aggregate state for its header glyph.
Vqro draws the fixed Pi-style glyph and its tone; the extension owns
only which state the row or panel is in.

view_id.description:
A panel root: the stable id of this view inside the pane's panel stack,
as the user names it to `vqro pane panel`. Only a root may set it.

waiting.description:
Whose move the row waits for. Vqro says "you" or names the terminal
link, which is the only party it can speak about live.

HostViewState.description:
The fixed state vocabulary Vqro draws a glyph and tone for: the same set the
Pi todo widget uses, so panels read like the rest of the UI.

oneOf.description: Waiting for someone to accept it: `◎`.

HostViewWaiting.description: Whose move a row waits for.

oneOf.description: The user of this client owes the action.
The row's terminal link owes the action; Vqro names it.

load_order.description:
Stable global load position. Lower values load first; later values win
deterministic contribution conflicts.

warnings.description:
Warnings collected at link time or on registry load (e.g. unknown event names,
missing manifest file). Non-fatal — the entry is kept and surfaced by plugin.list.

LayoutTreeDescription.description: Neutral, read-only tree export; independent from legacy pane-only layout methods.

oneOf.description:
A pane whose content is an extension view rather than a terminal. Its
scope is derived from placement and is not part of this export.

PaneLinkRegion.description: Inclusive display-cell columns on a pane's current viewport.

document_owner.description: Optional constrained document supplied by an enabled pane-inspector extension service.

PaneTelemetryProcess.description:
Privacy-safe process telemetry. Command arguments and environment variables are deliberately
not part of this response; callers must use an explicitly diagnostic API for those values.

cpu_tenths_percent.description: CPU utilization in tenths of a percent, calculated from two interest-driven samples.

granted_capabilities.description: Host-allowlisted protocol grants. These are not an OS sandbox.

requested_capabilities.description: Capabilities requested by trusted same-user service code.

oneOf.description: Outer popup size in terminal cells, including the border.
Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

RepositoryInfo.description:
Optional first-class repository projection. Workspace APIs remain available
for clients that do not understand this model.

oneOf.description:
Acknowledgement for the client-shell surface interest lease. This method is new on the
endpoint protocol, so its revision-bearing result can establish an activation floor.

endpoint_protocol_generation.description: Stable client-owned endpoint generation supported by this server.

health_check.description: Whether this server supports endpoint health probes.

surface_interest.description: Whether this server supports explicit client-shell surface interest.

collections.description: Authoritative collection organization, omitted when the session has none.

delegations.description: Authoritative delegation forest in deterministic preorder, omitted when empty.
